# grep and Extended Pattern Matching in Scripts

When using `grep` in scripts:
* Use `grep -q` (quiet) for testing conditions without output: `if grep -q "pattern" file; then ...`
* Use `grep -E` for modern ERE regexes.
* Use `grep -F` (fixed strings) when searching literal text (avoids regex compilation overhead).
